title: ID0393936-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/S3 300000004042] There is no connection on the Router-2
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
A connection couldn't be connected to Router-2 during the first commissioning. Router-1 is accessed, but there is no connection to Router-2 (10.20.17.2). When we run a network scanner, it didn't show 10.20.17.2. Device stuck 30% and commissioning didn't finish.
Root cause: Router Failure
Solution: Router Replacement
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Warranty Status: Active
Notes from ES to NOC [ 09/12/2024]
